title: ClickHouse MCP Server
summary: Let your agent run read-only SQL against ClickHouse and browse its databases and tables using ClickHouse's official MCP server.
description: mcp-clickhouse is ClickHouse's own MCP server. It gives the agent three tools: run a query, list databases and list tables, with paging and name filters for large schemas. That is enough to explore an analytics warehouse and draft queries against real column names.

Queries run with the readonly setting on by default, because CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS is false unless you change it. The ClickHouse user's grants remain the real boundary, so connect with an account that can only read.
useWhen: Explore an unfamiliar events table before writing a report query
Check a materialized view's output against the raw table
Find the slowest query patterns from system tables
Draft an aggregation and test it on a small time window

mcp.name: clickhouse

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_USER
env.description: A database user. Use one granted SELECT only.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_SECURE
env.description: Set to true to connect over HTTPS, which is the default.

access: Reads any table the ClickHouse user can select from
Read-only by default; writes need CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS set to true, which this setup leaves off

example.prompt: In the analytics database, count page_views per day for the last 7 days and note any day that dips below half the average.
example.result: Seven rows returned, averaging 41k views per day. Saturday shows 17k, under half the average, which matches the weekend traffic pattern.

faq.question: Can it drop or change tables?
faq.answer: Not with the defaults. Writes stay blocked until you set CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS, and destructive statements also need CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_DROP.

faq.question: Do I need uv installed?
faq.answer: Yes for this command. The project also documents a pip install with the mcp-clickhouse executable if you prefer that.

access: Runs read-only SQL as the ClickHouse user you configure
Lists databases and tables visible to that user
